historical_reuse: Subdivisions of the already inspected expanded study roles; these are retrospective same-source controls, not fresh confirmatory data.
partition_rule: Whole-identity nearest-image-target halves for real; deterministic shuffled row halves for generated sources. Every row is used exactly once within its parent role.

role_definitions.earlystop: Select a checkpoint by balanced Brier; no final access
role_definitions.selection_calibration: Development cell diagnostics; no model or setting selection
role_definitions.selection_evaluation: Development score diagnostics; no model or setting selection
role_definitions.test_calibration: Final score-cell RDR estimates and C.1/C.2 intervals
role_definitions.test_evaluation: Final Brier, null-RDR error and cell prediction means
role_definitions.train: Fit null models; only training rows determine feature standardization

role_seed_rule: split_seed + 100 * role_index + source_index; roles and sources follow role_order and source_order
